propositions: Add a 7th link relation type 'caused_by' to express bug provenance as a first-class directional graph edge following the 'discovered_from' precedent.

The 'caused_by' relation must be non-blocking and non-cycle-inducing; the hardcoded non-blocking tuple in src/rebar/graph/_graph.py line ~204 must include 'caused_by' to prevent incorrect block-cycle semantics.
Update the relation enum in common.schema.json, regenerate types.py Relation Literal, and add 'caused_by' to CANONICAL_RELATIONS in _links.py to propagate the new relation through the schema layer.

Keep 'caused_by' intentionally Jira-unmapped like 'discovered_from', 'duplicates', and 'supersedes'; update help text, CLI snapshots, and unlink.py usage strings across all enforcement and documentation sites.
Legacy LINK events without the new relation must continue to reduce without error; the change is purely additive with no persisted data rewrite and reversible back-out.
